newsitem.title: USA: Compaq names nine build-to-order partners.
newsitem.headline: Compaq names nine build-to-order partners.

text.p: Compaq Computer Corp said Tuesday it had named nine sales channel partners who will help it carry out its recently announced build-to-order personal computer production and distribution strategy.

The leading PC maker said its nine resale partners will be CompuCom Systems Inc, Electronic Data Systems Corp, ENTEX Information Services Inc., General Electric Co's GE Capital Information Technology Solutions, Inacom Corp, Ingram Micro Inc, MicroAge Inc, Tech Data Corp and Vanstar Corp.

The build-to-order strategy is designed to complement Compaq's industry-leading indirect sales efforts with a direct customer sales approach that can better compete with fast-growing direct marketers Dell Computer Corp, Gateway 2000 Inc and Micron Electronics Inc.
Compaq said the nine resale partnesr will provide it with product configuration and fulfillment services as it begins its build-to-order strategy in the fourth quarter of 1997.
Additional channel organizations may be added to the configuration program in the future, it said.
